# Module-level limits in scripts/ with no comment within four lines above them and no
# setting in scripts/settings.py (law 9). This is the debt as of 2026-09-27, not an
# allowance: tests/test_every_limit_states_its_reason.py fails if a name is added here
# by a new bare constant (the list must equal what the code holds), and a name leaves
# when its basis is written above it or it becomes a setting. Remove this file when it
# is empty. Classes: docs/LIMITS-2026-09-27.md.
